scientific_integrity: The classification follows from fixed valuations, an exact quadratic obstruction, the Chinese remainder theorem, and Dirichlet primes; finite regression checks are supporting evidence only. The p=109 calculation corrects the numeric prediction in the cited conjecture without altering the published record.
scientific_limitations: The result treats the divisor function modulo four on linear progressions; it does not assert higher two-adic congruences, nor that a bounded finite test proves the unrestricted classification.
title: A complete modulus-four criterion for divisor counts on arithmetic progressions
